content: The second major focus of the report is fleet customer intelligence, which explores the service needs and procurement methods of key fleet operators. The analysis includes detailed insights into the mining sector, where procurement practices and provider selection criteria are shaped by operational demands and collaborative opportunities. Similarly, the report investigates the requirements of road transport and logistics companies, emphasizing maintenance priorities and provider expectations, which are critical to their operational efficiency. It also includes visual representations of maintenance priorities for road transport and logistics companies, procurement preferences of mining fleet operators, and trends in outsourcing construction equipment fleet management. An analysis of the procurement methods and service preferences of South African mining fleet operators reveals three critical focus areas: the specific methods utilized for fleet acquisition, the precise service requirements of operators on the ground, and the multifaceted factors that influence provider selection and long-term collaboration. Understanding these interconnected elements is essential for navigating the competitive environment and delivering tailored solutions to mining enterprises operating within the region. In recent years, the procurement methods employed by mining fleet operators in South Africa have been heavily shaped by severe logistical challenges and supply chain vulnerabilities. Discussions and presentations at the Mining Indaba 2026 underscored the critical role of logistics within the mining sector, drawing particular attention to the severe disruptions caused by failures at Transnet [33] .
